title: Coconut Milkshake
summary: Whenever I want something creamy and cold that is not going to leave me sluggish afterward, I make this coconut milkshake. I use coconut cream, vanilla ice cream, and coconut milk, and blend them into…
ingredients: 1 cup vanilla ice cream (or vegan vanilla ice cream)
1 cup unsweetened coconut milk (or any milk)
steps: Add all ingredients except the sugar, to a high-speed blender and blend until smooth.
Adjust the sweetness by adding sugar if needed. If you add sugar make sure to blend for 1-2 minutes to incorporate it into the milkshake.
Adjust the consistency by adding more coconut milk if needed.
Serve immediately. To make it an even more decadent dessert, add a scoop of ice cream on top!
